g.text: He was gone for two years.
The world went on for fifty-eight.
When he steps out of the capsule, the wife he kissed
goodbye has been dead for decades, and the little girl
he promised to come home to is an old woman.
Earth is quieter now. Polite. A government called the
Continuity keeps everyone calm, and glowing Mirrors
watch every home. The past has been tidied away.
All he has left is a cheap steel watch, a lifetime of
missed birthdays, and one last chance to reach his
